## Lisbon Weekend Trip Snapshot
A 3-day Lisbon plan for **3 friends**, built around **seafood, one viewpoint, one museum, nightlife**, and **walking/public transit only**.
Budget target: **EUR 900 total excluding flights**; this plan keeps you around **EUR 780–860** depending on food and transit choices.

## 3-Day Lisbon Itinerary with Costs
Day 1: Baixa + Chiado + Ribeira dinner
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, easy walk through **Baixa** and **Chiado**; coffee + pastel de nata stop.
- Afternoon: Tram/metro to **Cais do Sodré** and riverfront stroll; keep this as a low-cost orientation day.
- Dinner: Seafood at a tascas-style spot near **Cais do Sodré** or **Bairro Alto**.
- Estimated cost for 3: **EUR 170–220**
  - Food/drinks: EUR 120–160
  - Transit: EUR 10–15
  - Small extras: EUR 40–45

Day 2: Scenic viewpoint + museum + sunset dinner
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Visit **Miradouro de Santa Catarina** or **Miradouro da Senhora do Monte** for your scenic viewpoint.
- Afternoon: Choose one museum: **Museu Nacional do Azulejo** for classic Lisbon culture, or **MAAT** for a more modern option.
- Dinner: Reserve a seafood dinner in **Alfama** or near **Time Out Market** for easy transit access.
Media: Alt=Dinner: Reserve a seafood dinner in **Alfama** or near **Time Out Market** for easy transit access, Lisbon, Portugal
- Estimated cost for 3: **EUR 210–280**
  - Museum tickets: EUR 15–30
  - Food/drinks: EUR 150–210
  - Transit: EUR 10–15
  - Viewpoint/other: EUR 35–45

Day 3: Alfama wander + lunch seafood + nightlife
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/music-note.svg
- Morning: Walk **Alfama** lanes, stop at a church/terrace, and keep the pace relaxed.
- Afternoon: Long seafood lunch near the river or in **Bairro Alto** before departure.
- Nightlife: Go for **Bairro Alto** bars or a **Cais do Sodré** music bar if you want a livelier scene.
- Estimated cost for 3: **EUR 180–240**
  - Food/drinks: EUR 140–190
  - Transit: EUR 10–15
  - Nightlife: EUR 30–35

## Stay Areas That Fit Your Budget and Transit Needs
Option 1: **Baixa/Chiado** | Best all-around base for walking, metro, and first-time visitors | Usually easiest for sightseeing and dining
Action: [Button: Search stays](https://www.booking.com/city/pt/lisbon.en-gb.html)

Option 2: **Cais do Sodré** | Best for river access, nightlife, and transit connections | Good if you want evenings out without taxis
Action: [Button: Search stays](https://www.booking.com/city/pt/lisbon/cais-do-sodre.en-gb.html)

Option 3: **Alfama** | Best atmosphere and viewpoints, but hillier and less convenient for luggage | Great if you want a classic Lisbon feel
Action: [Button: Search stays](https://www.booking.com/city/pt/lisbon/alfama.en-gb.html)

### Best fit for your group
- **Top pick: Baixa/Chiado** for the smoothest walking/transit access.
- **Best nightlife base: Cais do Sodré** if evenings matter most.
- **Best character: Alfama** if you do not mind hills.

## Budget Plan for the Weekend
- Lodging for 3 nights, 2 rooms or 1 larger apartment: **EUR 360–500**
- Food and seafood meals: **EUR 260–340**
- Transit passes / metro / trams: **EUR 25–45**
- Museum + viewpoint + small extras: **EUR 40–70**
- Nightlife drinks: **EUR 60–90**

**Total estimated spend:** **EUR 745–1,045**
**Practical target:** **EUR 780–860** if you keep one nicer seafood dinner and one lighter meal day.

## Rainy-Day Backup Plan
If weather turns wet, keep the same neighborhoods and swap outdoor time for indoor stops:
- **Museu Nacional do Azulejo** instead of a long walking loop
- **MAAT** for a modern indoor visit
- **Time Out Market** for a flexible lunch with many seafood options
- **Cafés in Chiado** for a slower afternoon
- **Fado house in Alfama** for a memorable indoor evening

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Lisbon transit](https://www.metrolisboa.pt/en/)
Action: [Button: Museum ideas](https://www.museudoazulejo.pt/en/)
Action: [Button: Nightlife area guide](https://www.visitlisboa.com/en)

- Visit Lisboa: https://www.visitlisboa.com/en
- Time Out Market Lisbon: https://www.timeoutmarket.com/lisboa/en/
